_question: Round 1 — Comet cycle W1: report wave-1 (N=15) catch counts and pre-register wave-2 protocol.

wave1.interpretation: Wave-1 result is directional: TG point estimate is strictly above both execution-based baselines on the same N=15 sample, but the head-to-head Fisher-exact p-value does not reach alpha=0.05 on either pair.  We do not upgrade this to a separation claim.

power_calculation.method: Conditioning on the per-tool wave-1 point estimates (TG 5/15, FT 2/15, Pytea 3/15) and assuming wave-2 catches are drawn at the same per-tool Bernoulli rates, locate the smallest N_new at which the pooled-sample Fisher exact two-sided p falls below 0.05.

wave2.inclusion_rule: identical mechanical rule as wave 1; next N_new PRs in chronological order matching the pre-registered query Q; no filter for TG-handleability, self-contained repro, or shape-only root cause
preregistered_primary_tests: Fisher exact two-sided on TG vs FakeTensorMode pooled wave-1+wave-2 catches
Fisher exact two-sided on TG vs Pytea pooled wave-1+wave-2 catches
Wilson 95% CI on TG catch-rate on pooled sample
